// Fork of "Fab17 #inktober2020 "storm"" by FabriceNeyret2. https://shadertoy.com/view/tsyyWW

#define R iResolution.xy

#define S(v)     smoothstep( 3., -3., (v)/min(.05,fwidth(v)) ) // AA draw
#define C(p,r)   S( length(p) - (r) )                          // circle
#define b(p,w,h) S( max( abs(p).x - (w), abs(p).y - (h) ) )    // box
#define B(C,A)   O =  mix( O, vec4((C)*(C),1), A )             // blend back to front

float s; // for seeding
#define hash(p,op)  fract(sin((p+s)*op(127.1,311.7, 269.5,183.3)) *43758.5453123)
#define rand(p)     hash(p,vec4) //  hash(p,mat2)
#define pol(p)   sqrt((p).x) * cos( 6.3*(p).y + vec2(0,11) )   // rand in disk
#define psin(x) ( .5 + .5* sin(6.3*(x)) )

void mainImage( out vec4 O, vec2 u )
{
    vec2 U = ( u+u - R ) / R.y, V=U;   
    float T, t = .3*iTime+10.,                 // wind and scroll timers
          j = floor(-5.*(U.y+.2)), y;          // --- differential scrolling strips
    O = j <= 0. ? max( vec4(.8*exp(-.5*U.y),1,1,1),  // sky + clouds
                       1.5*texture(iChannel0,U/vec2(7,1)+vec2(t*j/10.-.1*t,0),2.).r )
                : .3-j/6. + vec4(0,.7,(3.-j)/5.,1)   // ground
                           *(.8+.2*texture(iChannel0,U+vec2(t*j/2.,0),3.-j).r);
    O*=O; // because I accounted for gamma too late. Do it before tuning colors ;-)

    for( j=1.; j<4.; j++)                      // --- strips
    {                                                // --- sky strips
        U = 2.*V - vec2(6.*t*(j+1.),.3);             // strip frame
        s = 17.531*floor(U.x/4.);                    // seed per leave
        vec4 r = rand(.3);                           
        U.x = mod(U.x+.5+r.z,4.)-2.; U.y -= j-.7-r.w;// flying leave
        B( vec3(0,.5+.5*r.y,0), C(U+.05*cos(20.*t+vec2(0,11)),.03*j) );
                                                     // --- ground strips
        U = 2.*V + vec2(t*j,.3);                     // strip frame
        s = 17.531*floor(U.x/4.);                    // seed per tree
         r = rand(.3);
        U.x = mod(U.x+1.,4.)-2.4;                    // horizontal recycling
        B( .3-j/6. + .9*vec3(0,.7,(3.-j)/5.),        // bushes
           C(vec2(mod(U.x,.25)-.125,(U.y+.4*j+.1)*2.), .1) );
        y = (j+r.x)/4.;                       
        U.y +=  1.5*(y-.3); U.x += r.y-.5;           // depth + rand offset
        U.y+=.5; U *= 3. - 2.3*y; U.y-=.5;           // scale with depth
        T = iTime + .025*U.x;                        // elasticity & delay
        U.x -= (U.y+1.)* .3* ( psin(T) + .5*psin(3.7*T) )/1.5; // wind
        U.y+=.2; y = .8-y; 
        B( vec3( .2+.3*r.y, 0, y ), b(U,.1,.5));     // trunk
        U.y-=.5;
        for (float k=0.; k++ < 40.; )                // leaves
            r = rand(k),
            B( vec3( 0, .2+.6*r.w ,y ) +.2*r.xyz,    //     color
               C(U -.5*pol(r=rand(k+.5)), .18-.1*r.x));//   mask
    }
    O = sqrt(O);                                     // to sRGB
}
